story_zh: 李明开了一家小店。他保证商品质量，价格低，还经常打折。他提前安排进货，省时间。他的态度好，提供免费送货。生意发展很快，收入增加了一倍。他存了一些钱，想租更大的店。他获得成功，成为富有的商人。
story_pinyin: Lǐ Míng kāi le yī jiā xiǎo diàn. Tā bǎozhèng shāngpǐn zhìliàng, jiàgé dī, hái jīngcháng dǎzhé. Tā tíqián ānpái jìnhuò, shěng shíjiān. Tā de tàidù hǎo, tígōng miǎnfèi sònghuò. Shēngyì fāzhǎn hěn kuài, shōurù zēngjiā le yī bèi. Tā cún le yīxiē qián, xiǎng zū gèng dà de diàn. Tā huòdé chénggōng, chéngwéi fùyǒu de shāngrén.
story_en: Li Ming opened a small shop. He guarantees product quality, keeps prices low, and often offers discounts. He arranges inventory in advance to save time. His attitude is good, and he provides free delivery. The business develops quickly, and his income has doubled. He saved some money and wants to rent a larger shop. He achieved success and became a wealthy businessman.
